title: John Mack's experiencer support group and its two camps

tellings.quote: when I went to his support groups, I noticed that they were in my from my perspective, I saw two different camps of people.

plain: The psychiatrist John Mack ran support groups near Boston for "experiencers," people who say they have been in contact with or taken by aliens, and Jim Weiner says the people in them split into two camps. Weiner, who says he was taken himself, went to the groups and tells Michels: "I saw two different camps of people." He tells it as a sign that people who report the same kind of experience do not all understand it the same way.
